hero.title: Chulha Chauki da Dhaba: Bangalore's Best Dhaba-Style Dining Awaits!
hero.subtitle: Experience the quintessential Dhaba in a lighter and more fun ambience.

about.title: Our Dhaba Story
about.paragraph1: Amongst the best family restaurants in Bangalore, Chulha Chauki da Dhaba serves delicious North Indian and Punjabi food with rich flavours and enticing aroma made from high quality ingredients.
about.paragraph2: Experience the classy rustic style ambience of a Highway Dhaba and enjoy spiced up lip smacking Dhaba style food served with warmth. We pride ourselves on consistent quality, a youthful ambiance, good quantity, and a unique taste that sets us apart as Bangalore's favorite culinary destination.
